subject.title: [AI] fix(embedding): retry without dimensions and degrade non-local providers on persistent failure

question: Should optional non-local memory embedding providers degrade to FTS-only after persistent runtime failures while explicitly configured non-local providers continue to fail closed?
rationale: The code path is plausible, but fallback behavior changes provider failure semantics and repository policy treats fallback behavior as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept optional-mode degradation after repair
options.body: Merge with the current optional/required boundary once the circuit-breaker latching bug is fixed and exact-head checks are refreshed.

options.title: Require broader live memory-index proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted full memory-index run proves the behavior against a rejecting OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

options.title: Split the degradation change
options.body: Merge a narrower dimensions-retry fix first and decide optional non-local degradation in a separate maintainer-approved change.

recommendation.title: Accept optional-mode degradation after repair
recommendation.body: Merge with the current optional/required boundary once the circuit-breaker latching bug is fixed and exact-head checks are refreshed.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision directly touches the explicit-provider fail-closed behavior and memory config contract they introduced.
